channel.title: Pocket releases
channel.description: Every published version of Pocket, the private finance app.

item.title: Pocket 3.2.11
item.description: The HRA exemption follows the city you rent in, and a premium's due date keeps its day. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access; macOS, Linux and Android too. The previous build was 3.2.10 (12 October 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.2.10
item.description: Health insurance now counts in the old regime's tax (80D), as the law allows. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access; macOS, Linux and Android too. The previous build was 3.2.9 (12 October 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.2.9
item.description: A correction to Pocket's income-tax figures. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access; macOS, Linux and Android too. The previous build was 3.2.8 (11 October 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.2.8
item.description: Pocket can now encrypt your data on your Windows computer. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access. The previous build was 3.2.7 (11 October 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.2.7
item.description: Pocket can now tell you when a newer version is out. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access. The previous build was 3.2.6 (11 October 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.2.6
item.description: Pocket on Windows is now an app in a window of its own, not a tab in your browser. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access. The previous build was 3.2.5 (11 October 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.2.5
item.description: Pocket on Windows now runs from its tray icon alone, and is sharp on high-resolution screens. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access. The previous build was 3.2.4 (10 October 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.2.4
item.description: A smaller download, and the phone app made ready for the app stores. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access. The previous build was 3.2.3 (10 October 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.2.3
item.description: A proper Windows installer, figures that read like a person's own month, and a plan that the clock and a deleted setting can no longer move. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access. The previous build was 3.2.2 (8 October 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.2.2
item.description: Comparisons that compare like with like, plainer words on Tax, and fixes found trying the phone app on Android. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access. The previous build was 3.2.1 (6 October 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.2.1
item.description: The price lists now say only what Pocket does. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access. The previous build was 3.2.0 (6 October 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.2.0
item.description: A direct download, and fixes found finishing the phone app and trying it on Android. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access. The previous build was 3.1.0 (5 October 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.1.0
item.description: The redesign, finished on the dashboard and the phone view (/m), and a wave of features and fixes found along the way. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access. The previous build was 3.0.0 (28 September 2026).

item.title: Pocket 3.0.0
item.description: The first build named Pocket (it had an earlier name). Windows 10/11, 64-bit, early access. The previous build was v2.1.0 (20 September 2026), under its earlier name.
